name: Hatoyama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hatoyama town emblem in green: a stylised dove with a raised wing enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Hatoyama, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 5 April 1973.

features.role: Hatoyama town emblem — a stylised dove with a raised wing enclosing a ring
